notes: Style match is excellent (same athlete, gym, light, wardrobe). Two controlled reps, feet planted, bar to mid-chest, soft lockout, loop almost closes. Fail: grip is still narrow and reads close to the existing close-grip-bench-press clip rather than a standard medium bench grip; elbows stay fairly tucked.

Best of three deadlift attempts (v2). Conventional lift from the floor, black trainers, plates return to the floor, lockout is clean with no lean-back, loop closes. Fail: camera is a front three-quarter, not the required true side-on (spine line is harder to judge); only one full rep in 8s rather than 2-3; hips a little high on the first pull. v1 was rejected (rear view, second rep turned into an RDL, loop did not close).

Best of three pull-up attempts (v3, start and end frames locked to a dead hang). First and last frames hang with feet off the floor; two attempted reps; grip is about shoulder width and overhand. Fail: camera is three-quarter front, not side-on; chin never clearly clears the bar (short range of motion); mid-clip the feet drop to the floor twice as the bar height morphs; the bar is a multi-grip unit, not a plain straight bar. v1 and v2 also failed on floor contact and incomplete ROM.
